cohort: The article discusses the health and wellbeing of new mothers and their newborns, focusing on the content and importance of the 6-8 week postnatal check.
finding: This article explores common postnatal themes and medical conditions, emphasizing their early recognition and management during the 6-8 week postnatal check for new mothers and their newborns.
mod_finding: The physical review during the 6-8 week postnatal check includes wound healing after caesarian section and pelvic floor health related to vaginal tears.
